newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope resumes private audiences after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Pope resumes private audiences after surgery.

text.p: Pope John Paul on Monday held a private audience for the first time since he had surgery to remove his appendix earlier this month.
The Vatican said the 76-year-old Pontiff received Archbishops from Lithuania, Latvia and Chile as well as a group of pilgrims from his native Poland.
The Pope, who has repeatedly condemned the recent liberalisation of Polish abortion laws, spoke to the pilgrims about the family and social values but did not mention abortion.
The Pontiff on Sunday participated in the first public religious ceremony since his October 8 operation. On Wednesday, he is due to begin regular weekly general audiences again.
